title: ReplyArc

helpArticles.title: What is ReplyArc?
helpArticles.body:
ReplyArc is an AI agent for your website that answers visitor questions using your own content, in your brand voice.
It captures leads, books appointments, and hands over to a human the moment someone asks.
You can try it right here: this chat runs on ReplyArc.

helpArticles.title: How do I add the widget to my site?
helpArticles.body:
Copy the one-line snippet from your dashboard and paste it before the closing body tag on your site. That is it, no rebuild needed.
The widget picks up your brand colours automatically, and everything is adjustable in the Widget studio.

helpArticles.title: Which languages does the widget speak?
helpArticles.body:
The visitor chat ships in English, Chinese, Malay, Tamil and Thai, and follows each visitor’s browser language automatically.
The AI itself replies in whatever language the visitor writes in.

helpArticles.title: How does conversation pricing work?
helpArticles.body:
You pay per genuine conversation: a visitor question your agent actually answers. Casual opens and greetings do not count.
Every plan includes a monthly allowance; the pricing page has the current plans.

helpArticles.title: What happens to my visitors’ data?
helpArticles.body:
Conversations are stored so you can read and continue them from your inbox. We strip tracking parameters from page URLs and never sell visitor data.
The privacy policy has the full details.
